scope: Correct AC1015 LTYPE_CONTROL Numentries from BS to BL per ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1 section 20.4.57, preserving other versions and the existing ordering of special linetype references. No general LTYPE interoperability claim.

producer_witness.method: Locally authored ezdxf 1.4.5 R2010 DXFs with CONTINUOUS plus 254, 255 or 256 named ordinary linetypes and one LINE were converted to AC1015 DWG using ODA File Converter 27.1.0, ACAD2000 DWG, recursion=0, audit=0. All inputs and outputs remain scratch-only. The source object location and CRC were independently traced with GNU LibreDWG 0.14; the count bit spans and following handle bytes were then independently decoded directly from the original AC1015 on-disk frame rather than trusting LibreDWG's BS field interpretation.
producer_witness.bit_offsets: All source control bodies start at byte 2985 in these exact files. After the common preamble, count starts at body bit 62. 255 has BL tag 01 and ends at bit 72, the declared data/handle boundary; 256 and 257 have BL tag 00 plus 32-bit little-endian payload and end at bit 96, again exactly the boundary. The next tokens are role-4 null and role-3 null, followed by count ordinary role-2 references and two role-3 references. LibreDWG's own trace labels the field BS and consequently misaligns the 256/257 tails; its small-count trace alone cannot distinguish BL and BS.
producer_witness.special_order_disposition: The producer's two final role-3 handles physically resolve to ByBlock then ByLayer, while the PDF says the linetypes end with BYLAYER and BYBLOCK. This separate authority/ordering conflict remains unresolved. This change does not reorder or alter any special handles and does not treat producer output as overriding the PDF.

implementation.writer: Only AC1015 LTYPE_CONTROL writes BL. Other version and control count behavior remains unchanged; count values below 256 have the same compact bytes as before.
implementation.reader: For AC1015 LTYPE_CONTROL, compact tags 01/10 decode as BL and must end at the declared data/handle boundary when one is present; the prior objSize=0 compact route is preserved. A full-width BL tag 00, including a noncanonical encoding of a small count, is accepted when it ends exactly at the nonzero declared boundary. A BS candidate is admitted only in the old writer's canonical forms (tag 11 for 256, tag 00 for 257+), when uniquely selected by that boundary and the entire previous-writer profile is validated on an independent cursor: fixed LTYPE_CONTROL identity, zero EED/reactors, typed-null owner/extension sentinels, all absolute non-null unique role-2 children, first three ByBlock/ByLayer/Continuous fixed identities, complete tail and at most seven zero padding bits. Invalid, ambiguous or unbounded extended forms fail closed; object parsing resets on failure. No speculative special-order correction is included.

validation.generated: libdxfrw_dwg_ac1015_ltype_count verifies direct writer BL frame/declared boundary/following sentinels and reader BL/previous BS forms at 255, 256 and 257; bounded noncanonical full-width BL values 0, 1 and 255 are accepted. Corrupted owner, fixed identity, duplicate child, boundary and truncation are refused, followed by same-control retry. Adjacent control-slot and table-recovery CTests pass. Combined focused run 3/3.
validation.historical: The previous HEAD writer source blob 3634f4ba6c6fbc132b625f811187fc215677b358 was compiled separately in scratch and generated genuine BS count 256 and 257 control bodies, SHA-256 3dc2a631276fd400fe4cb8e38c9e3adc0c1d0f90dc2f74cf38774ec5dbc93baa and de90cc82f94c03c74919b31bcd9a1260745fe05037d13c9d4005bdda89e6a056. The updated reader parsed 258 and 259 ordered handle slots respectively.
validation.physical_readback: The updated native reader independently opened the three ODA-produced AC1015 files and delivered respectively 257, 258 and 259 unique LTYPE names (including ByBlock, ByLayer and Continuous) and the following LINE. A scratch mutation of the physical 255 file changed only its declared body boundary from 72 to 73 bits and recomputed the object CRC (original verified, resealed CRC 0x3234; mutated DWG SHA-256 ea3baff8370ee486ba74fe6774630bba4930ccb9e69610f356ea21c4c3d2f73e); the updated reader rejected it. Generated compact-gap controls for 0, 1 and 255 verify same-object successful retry. This checks reading only and does not resolve the separate ordering disagreement.

limits: No statement is made for AC1018/AC1021/AC1024/AC1027/AC1032 count encoding or old-writer compatibility, nonconforming third-party legacy BS profiles, the unresolved linetype special ordering, general visual semantics, or native consumer parity. No DWG/DXF fixture is committed.
